parameters.query: SELECT id, user_id as owner_user_id, status FROM profiles WHERE id = '{{ $json["profile_id"] }}' LIMIT 1;

-- Check existing open chat between initiator and profile owner
SELECT id FROM chat_sessions WHERE profile_id = '{{ $json["profile_id"] }}' AND initiator_user_id = '{{ $json["initiator_user_id"] }}' AND status = 'OPEN' LIMIT 1;

-- Check if initiator is blocked by owner (global or session-level block)
SELECT 1 FROM chat_blocks cb JOIN chat_sessions cs ON cb.chat_id = cs.id WHERE cs.profile_id = '{{ $json["profile_id"] }}' AND cb.blocked_user_id = '{{ $json["initiator_user_id"] }}' LIMIT 1;

-- Create session (idempotent guard)
WITH owner AS (SELECT user_id AS owner_user_id FROM profiles WHERE id = '{{ $json["profile_id"] }}')
INSERT INTO chat_sessions (profile_id, initiator_user_id, respondent_user_id, status)
SELECT '{{ $json["profile_id"] }}', '{{ $json["initiator_user_id"] }}', owner.owner_user_id, 'OPEN' FROM owner
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_sessions WHERE profile_id = '{{ $json["profile_id"] }}' AND initiator_user_id = '{{ $json["initiator_user_id"] }}' AND status = 'OPEN')
RETURNING id;

-- If row exists, select existing id as fallback
SELECT id FROM chat_sessions WHERE profile_id = '{{ $json["profile_id"] }}' AND initiator_user_id = '{{ $json["initiator_user_id"] }}' AND status = 'OPEN' LIMIT 1;
INSERT INTO audit_events (user_id, event_type, event_data) VALUES ('{{ $json["initiator_user_id"] }}', 'chat_session_create', jsonb_build_object('profile_id','{{ $json["profile_id"] }}') );
